# Cell types
cell_types = ['Astro', 'EpC', 'FB','Oligo', 'OPC', 'ExN', 'InN', 'DaN', 'MG', 'EC', 'PC', 'TC' ]


# Subtypes
data_dir = '/data/CARD_singlecell/Brain_atlas/SN_Multiome/'
work_dir = '/data/CARD_singlecell/SN_atlas/' 
gene_markers_file = work_dir+'/input/example_marker_genes.csv'
# Keep consistent font sizes

# Make sure the text is editable in .svg format, we are using Arial
plt.rcParams['svg.fonttype'] = 'none' 
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = 'Arial'

# Set figure context
#sns.set_context('paper')
# Disease colors
disease_colors = ['#7f7f7f', '#5ab4e5', '#d36027', '#7570b3']

# Convert inches to centimeters
cm = 1/2.54

# Font sizes for publication
SMALL_SIZE = 3
MEDIUM_SIZE = 5
BIGGER_SIZE = 5
normal_size = 12

# Set the font sizes for the figures
plt.rc('font', size=normal_size)          # controls default text sizes
plt.rc('axes', titlesize=normal_size)     # fontsize of the axes title
plt.rc('axes', labelsize=normal_size)    # fontsize of the x and y labels
plt.rc('xtick', labelsize=normal_size)    # fontsize of the tick labels
plt.rc('ytick', labelsize=normal_size)    # fontsize of the tick labels
plt.rc('legend', fontsize=normal_size, title_fontsize=normal_size)    # legend fontsize

### Using holoviews


```python
mdata.obs['UMAP1'] = mdata.obsm['X_umap'][:, 0]
mdata.obs['UMAP2'] = mdata.obsm['X_umap'][:, 1]

genes = ['GFAP', 'GAD1', 'MOG']
idx = mdata[:, mdata.var_names.isin(genes)].mod['rna'].obs_names
gene_df = pd.DataFrame(mdata[:, mdata.var_names.isin(genes)].mod['rna'].layers['log-norm'].todense())
gene_df.index = idx
gene_df.columns = genes
gene_df
```
